meta.name: financial-reporting-and-close
meta.description: Runs the period-end close and produces reporting — close calendar, reconciliations, accruals, variance analysis, and reporting that gets read. Use this to shorten or stabilize a monthly close, design a close checklist, investigate a variance, structure management reporting, or work out why the numbers keep changing after close.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成月度结账,并输出财务报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每月月底需要手工对账出报表,还常被数字对不上困扰。
copy.tagline_en: Automate your month-end close and produce reliable financial reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spend late nights on manual reconciliations and the numbers keep shifting.

howto.what: 它会按流程组织期末结账:排出结账日历和检查清单(负责人、依赖、硬性截止),逐账户对账并解释差异,按证据记应计费用并留依据,用预算或上期基准做差异分析,报告先讲两三点关键变化及原因。
howto.when: 当你要求缩短或稳定月度结账、设计结账检查清单、或查清某项差异时,它会接管;相近的结账与报告需求也会触发。

say.text: 帮我设计本月的结账关键路径,标出每步负责人和依赖。
say.note: 你会得到带所有者和先后顺序的结账日历。

say.text: 为什么这个月的折旧费比预测高这么多?
say.note: 它会说明对比基准,并区分是时点原因还是持续原因。

say.text: 给我一份本月结账差异分析,先说最重要的两三点变化。
say.note: 报告先给结论和关键原因,再放支撑细节。

howto.what_en: Runs month-end close as a workflow: calendar/checklist with owners/dependencies/cutoff; reconciliations explain differences; accruals on evidence; variance vs baseline; report leads with key changes and reasons.
howto.when_en: Useful when you ask to shorten or stabilize a monthly close, design a close checklist, or investigate a variance; also for related close/reporting needs.

say_en.text: Map this month's close critical path with owners and dependencies.
say_en.note: You get a close calendar with sequence and ownership.

say_en.text: Why is this month's depreciation so far above forecast?
say_en.note: It states the baseline and separates timing from run-rate.

say_en.text: Write a post-close variance summary, starting with the main changes.
say_en.note: It leads with key causes, then detail.
